summary.title: 2D breakout game using Phaser
summary.one_liner: You learn to build a simple mobile-friendly breakout game in JavaScript with the Phaser framework, covering rendering, collisions, controls, animations, and win/lose states.
keywords: how to make a breakout game in javascript
takeaways: Build a simple mobile-friendly breakout game in JavaScript using the Phaser framework.
Learn core game mechanics in Phaser: rendering and moving images, collision detection, and control mechanisms.
Use Phaser helper functions, animations and tweens, and implement winning and losing states.
Phaser was chosen for its browser support, active community, and plugin set; pure JavaScript knowledge helps when the framework falls short.
A sister guide builds the same game in pure JavaScript with visually identical results.
summary.summary: This MDN tutorial walks through creating a simple mobile-friendly Breakout game in JavaScript using the Phaser framework. It is split into step-by-step parts, each with editable live samples so readers can check intermediate results. Topics include rendering and moving images, collision detection, controls, animations and tweens, and winning and losing states. The guide expects basic to intermediate JavaScript knowledge, and it has a sister guide that builds the same game in pure JavaScript.
